title: IO-mode stratified latency grid by model & route
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: build a performant, drillable grid-style dashboard that breaks out p50/p95/p99 latency by model and route with an explicit stratification by IO mode (streaming vs non-streaming). The view needs to support fast pivots (model-family, route prefix, customer tag), an error-rate overlay, and direct trace links. This will be the primary tool for on-call and SRE to quickly triage regressions that differ by IO mode or by model variant.

Scope: frontend dashboard panels + backend metric rollups and tagging. Necessary ingestion changes include adding explicit 'io_mode' label to our latency histograms and ensuring route and model identifiers are preserved through the metrics/log pipeline (Vector -> Prometheus remote write -> Cortex). We also need small tracing-hooks work to attach the trace_id to sampled requests shown in the dashboard drilldown.

Out of scope: long-term sampling rework for tracing; that will be a follow-up (see dependencies).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows a grid where rows are model family (e.g., redwood-1, llama-2-70b) and columns are route (api/chat, api/generate, api/embed), each cell displays p50/p95/p99 latency metrics for both streaming and non-streaming IO mode side-by-side
Time-window selector (1m/5m/1h/24h) updates all cells within 2s for 1m/5m windows when using cached rollups
Error-rate overlay can be toggled and highlights cells where error rate increased >2x from baseline
Clicking a cell opens a drill pane with top traces (linked to Jaeger) and a lightweight sample table with request_shape, kv_cache_hit, tokens_out, and trace link
Metric cardinality increase due to new labels limited to <12% (baseline: last 30d) by coalescing route prefixes and using model_family rather than full version when appropriate

Automated tests for correct labeling in ingestion (unit + integration test against local Cortex test cluster), and an e2e smoke test that verifies a synthetic request writes metrics and appears on the grid within the chosen window
tasks: Schema change: add 'io_mode' label to latency histogram (sync|stream)
Metrics pipeline: ensure route and model tags are preserved; add transform to normalize route prefixes
Dashboard: implement grid rendering, toggles for streaming vs non-streaming and error-rate overlay
Tracing: small hook to attach trace_id and kv_cache_hit boolean to sampled spans
Perf: add caching layer on dashboard server to keep 1m/5m queries low-latency
QA: run high-cardinality simulation to validate ingestion cost and rollup correctness
decisions: Use model_family instead of full model_version in primary grid to control cardinality
Normalize route to top-3 prefixes by default, with an 'Other' bucket for low-volume routes
Sample traces at existing sampling rates; expose a 'force-sample' button for individual drill sessions rather than increase global sampling
Implement server-side cached rollups for 1m/5m windows rather than querying raw histograms for each cell to keep dashboard latency low
tradeoffs: Cardinality vs fidelity: collapsing to model_family and route-prefix reduces resolution for very specific variants but keeps ingestion cost manageable
Trace sampling vs coverage: keeping current sampling prevents cost spikes but may mean the drill pane lacks traces for low-frequency regressions
Precomputed rollups reduce dashboard latency but add background job complexity and eventual consistency for very recent windows
